lines.when: At start, once per validation warning
lines.stream: Standard error; never coloured; not logged

lines.when: Sources are stale or learning decisions changed
The launch contract is invalid

lines.line: `[DRY-RUN] contract <id> is source-current; no actions or writes will occur`
lines.when: First line of a dry run
Dry run, once per preflight-timed precondition of each stage that will run
Dry run, a smoke stage without `--smoke`

lines.line: `[CHECK] <stage> uses existing prerequisite; --implement would run setup`
lines.when: Dry run, a setup stage without `--implement`
Dry run, every other stage
Last line of a dry run

lines.line: `[BLOCKED] another launcher owns <pipeline run>` then `[DIGEST] state=failed exit=24 last-stage=none evidence=<pipeline run>`
lines.when: The lock is held

lines.line: `[BLOCKED] <failure>` once per preflight failure, then `[DIGEST] state=failed exit=21 last-stage=none evidence=<pipeline run>`
lines.when: Preflight failed
Live run, a smoke stage without `--smoke`

lines.line: `[RESUME] <stage> postconditions still hold; skipping` or `[RESUME] <stage> postconditions changed; rerunning`
lines.when: A stage that was completed in an earlier launch
Setup stage, no `--implement`, postconditions hold
Setup stage, no `--implement`, a postcondition fails
A stage-timed precondition failed
Each stage attempt
The action exited 0 and the postconditions hold
The action exited 0 and a postcondition failed
A stage attempt failed and will be retried
A stage failed for good

lines.line: `[DIGEST] state=<failed or stopped> exit=<code> last-stage=<id> child-exit=<code or None> evidence=<pipeline run>`
lines.when: A stage failed or the run was stopped

lines.line: `[DIGEST] state=completed exit=0 last-stage=<id of the last stage of the launch contract, even if skipped> evidence=<pipeline run>`
lines.when: Every stage complete
